lrw.text: Oona uses the Great Aurora to control Lorwyn-Shadowmoor, manipulating its celestial cycle so that it alternates every 300 years.
When the Great Mending disrupts the cycle, she fears she may be affected, senses the Aurora approaching prematurely and plots to remain in power and unchanged through the transformation.

She creates Oko as a vessel for her memories, but he turns against her and flees, so she creates Maralen and instills her with a piece of her own soul, and also makes the Vendilion siblings in the final days before the Aurora.
Fearing the Aurora, Oona kills the elf Maralen and replaces her with a faerie vessel as a mental duplicate, but the new Maralen becomes independent and turns against her creator.

mor.text: The Vendilion clique whisks Maralen away to Glen Elendra as a gift to Oona, and then learns that she is a faerie duplicate and begins to obey her.

shm.text: Oona, queen of the fae, bottles the sky one night and releases it the next after aligning the stars, and she sends her Vendilion clique to spy on Colfenor.
She kills the elf Maralen and replaces her with her half-formed daughter, who gains unintended sentience, so conflict grows between them.
Oona tries to take Ashling's elemental power but is thwarted by Maralen, Brigid Baeli and Sygg, then retreats to Cayr Ulios and drains the elves, until Gryffid sacrifices himself to sever her hold.

Oona is defeated at Glen Elendra with the sacrifice of the Sapling of Colfenor and the combined power of Maralen and Ashling's elemental, though her consciousness survives and Maralen becomes queen of the fae.

eve.text: Oona kills the Sapling of Colfenor, but Maralen steals Ashling's power with the scroll and Crescent and challenges her.
Maralen, with Rhys, Ashling and two elementals, destroys Oona with moonglove and becomes queen of the fae.
Even so, Oona's consciousness survives, and she is reborn in secret in Glen Elendra.

ecl.text: Oona, who once controlled the plane's cycle of day and night, creates a duplicate Maralen and gives it a piece of her soul to preserve her memories after the Great Mending disrupts the Great Aurora cycle and makes her fear she might be affected.
After the plane turns to Shadowmoor, a coalition of Maralen, Rhys, Brigid, Sygg, Ashling and Colfenor defeats her, ending her control but leaving the plane's aspects bleeding into one another.
Maralen, whom Oona made as a weapon-avatar, finds petals of Oona's flesh in her chamber and sees Oona's gaze in the mirror, and she warns her students that Oona is returning.
Rhys approaches Maralen with a poisoned dagger, calling her Oona, but Oko tells him Maralen is not Oona reborn and spares him.
